mirror_field_validation.claim: payload[0xC38] == 1 reads the native celestial_mirror_obtained bool, file offset 0xC78 (3192); EV01 writes 1 to its underlying SaveData field in the Macalania Woods event.
chain: EV01 SaveData slot0xA4C (2636) serializes at EV01 SaveData base0x1EC + slot = Fahrenheit payload offset0xC38.
Save payload uses a 64-byte header; payload0xC38 maps to save-file offset0xC78 (3192).
Fahrenheit native SaveData layout labels FieldOffset(0xC38) as bool celestial_mirror_obtained (savedata.cs:259).

Production EBP mc/mcfr0100/mcfr0100.ebp (SHA-256 63466cb214dfb0bc4bc44d719cd42b49a007f201078986ddbb72d5157cd12fa3) has SaveData slot0xA4C one-byte POPV stores at ATEL PCs0x198D and0x7C4D; each is preceded by PUSHII1.
mirror_field_validation.limits: This is native field definition plus production event write proof, not runtime/save-file observation. Exact scene text tying the write to the restoration-completion interaction rather than an earlier step was not recovered in this pass; preserve medium confidence for that semantic nuance.

mirror.payload_to_file_mapping: payload offset 0xC38 + 0x40-byte save header = file offset 0xC78 (3192); this is also FFX Fahrenheit SaveData slot 0xA4C (2636) + EV01 SaveData base 0x1EC = Fh offset 0xC38, then +64-byte file header.

native_writer.instruction: POPV var[1]; var descriptor is SaveData slot 2636, one byte.

mirror.unresolved: The native writer is in Macalania Woods and writes the SaveData field named celestial_mirror_obtained=1. No claim is made that a live save was observed.
